conversations.title: Top Selling Products and Stock Status

turns.user: What are our top 3 best-selling products by revenue?
turns.sql: SELECT p.name AS product_name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS units_sold, SUM(oi.total_price) AS total_revenue FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON p.id = oi.product_id JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status IN ('delivered', 'shipped') GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 3;
turns.explanation: Calculates revenue by product name across completed orders and returns the top 3.

turns.user: Do we have sufficient inventory in stock for those products?
turns.sql: SELECT p.name AS product_name, pv.title AS variant_title, SUM(inv.quantity_on_hand) AS total_stock, SUM(inv.quantity_reserved) AS total_reserved FROM products p JOIN product_variants pv ON p.id = pv.product_id JOIN inventory_items inv ON pv.id = inv.variant_id WHERE p.name IN (SELECT p2.name FROM products p2 JOIN order_items oi ON p2.id = oi.product_id JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status IN ('delivered', 'shipped') GROUP BY p2.name ORDER BY SUM(oi.total_price) DESC LIMIT 3) GROUP BY p.name, pv.title ORDER BY p.name, total_stock DESC;
turns.explanation: Filters inventory for the top 3 best-selling products identified in the previous turn.

turns.user: Show me our Platinum tier customers and their lifetime spending.
turns.sql: SELECT u.email, CONCAT(u.first_name, ' ', u.last_name) AS customer_name, cp.lifetime_spend, cp.loyalty_points FROM users u JOIN customer_profiles cp ON u.id = cp.user_id WHERE cp.membership_tier = 'platinum' ORDER BY cp.lifetime_spend DESC;
turns.explanation: Lists all platinum tier customers sorted by highest monetary spend.

turns.sql: SELECT o.id, o.order_number, u.email, o.status, o.total_amount, o.placed_at FROM orders o JOIN users u ON o.user_id = u.id JOIN customer_profiles cp ON u.id = cp.user_id WHERE cp.membership_tier = 'platinum' ORDER BY o.placed_at DESC LIMIT 10;
turns.explanation: Follow-up displaying recent orders placed specifically by platinum tier customers.
